name: Pronouns and Relative Clauses
description: Personal, possessive, reflexive, indefinite and relative pronouns, plus defining and non-defining relative clauses.

passages.title: Our New Neighbours
passages.content:
A new family moved into the flat next to (1) ______ one last week. The parents are teachers, and (2) ______ two children go to my school.

The girl, Mira, is in my class, and I helped (3) ______ find the library on her first day. Her brother is younger, but he already knows (4) ______ way around. Yesterday Mira invited my sister and (5) ______ to her birthday party.

passages.title: Cooking for the First Time
passages.content:
When our parents went away for the weekend, my brother and I decided to cook dinner by (1) ______. We found a recipe online, but neither of (2) ______ had ever made pasta before.

I cut (3) ______ while I was chopping the onions, so my brother had to finish the job. The sauce was so salty that (4) ______ of us could eat more than a few spoonfuls. In the end we ordered a pizza, and (5) ______ of us blamed the other.

passages.title: The Book That Travelled the World
passages.content:
Five years ago a woman in Lviv left a novel on a park bench with a note inside: 'Whoever finds this book, please read (1) ______ and leave it somewhere new.' Since then the book has been to twelve countries, and everyone (2) ______ picks it up writes a short message on the inside cover.

A student in Portugal, Ana, wrote that the book had changed (3) ______ life. Last month a man who had found it in Canada posted a photo online, and the woman recognised her own handwriting. 'I never thought (4) ______ would get this far,' she said. 'The messages are not really mine any more. They are (5) ______.'

passages.title: Twins Who Swapped Places
passages.content:
When Oksana and Olena were ten, they discovered that nobody at school could tell (1) ______ apart. For a whole week they swapped classes, and not a single teacher noticed. 'We had agreed not to tell (2) ______, not even our best friends,' Oksana remembers.

The trick was finally uncovered by their grandmother, (3) ______ eyesight was better than anyone else's. 'She looked at me and said: "You are Olena, and your sister is pretending to be (4) ______."' Today both sisters are doctors, and patients still sometimes confuse one with (5) ______.

questions.title: That laptop is not mine. I think it belongs to ___.
questions.explanation: Після прийменника «to» вживають об'єктну форму займенника.

questions.title: The children made the decorations ___.
questions.explanation: Підмет і виконавець збігаються, тому потрібен зворотний займенник.

questions.title: This is the teacher ___ helped me with my project.
questions.explanation: «Who» уживають щодо людей.

questions.title: I have got a bicycle ___ tyres need replacing.
questions.explanation: «Whose» указує на належність.

questions.title: Is there ___ in the room? I heard a noise.
questions.explanation: У питанні вживають «anybody».

questions.title: ___ of my classmates has a different plan for the summer.
questions.explanation: «Each» вимагає дієслова в однині.

questions.title: The keys are on the shelf. Please give them to ___.
questions.explanation: Після прийменника вживають об'єктну форму «me».

questions.title: Which sentence uses a possessive adjective correctly?
options: Their house is near the river.
Theirs house is near the river.
They house is near the river.
Them house is near the river.
questions.explanation: Присвійний прикметник стоїть перед іменником: their house.

questions.title: Nothing ___ been decided so far.
questions.explanation: «Nothing» вимагає дієслова в однині.

questions.title: The film ___ we watched last night was based on a true story.
questions.explanation: У defining relative clause можна вживати «that».

questions.title: Help ___ to some more salad.
questions.explanation: Зворотний займенник другої особи однини — «yourself».

questions.title: ___ is a long way from the station to the hotel.
questions.explanation: У конструкції про відстань підметом виступає «it».

questions.title: ___ were a lot of people waiting outside the theatre.
questions.explanation: Конструкція наявності починається з «there».

questions.title: Which pronoun replaces 'the students' as an object?
questions.explanation: Об'єктна форма для «the students» — «them».

questions.title: Match each subject pronoun with its possessive pronoun.
questions.explanation: Присвійні займенники вживають замість іменника, а не перед ним.

questions.title: Match each relative pronoun with the thing it refers to.
questions.explanation: Кожен відносний займенник має свою сферу вживання.

questions.title: Match each indefinite pronoun with the sentence it completes.
pairs: There is somebody at the door.
Did anybody phone while I was out?
questions.explanation: Вибір неозначеного займенника залежить від типу речення.

questions.title: Match each reflexive pronoun with its subject.
questions.explanation: Зворотний займенник має збігатися з підметом в особі й числі.

questions.title: The report, ___ was published last week, has already been criticised.
questions.explanation: Non-defining clause виділяється комами й не допускає «that».

questions.title: The village ___ my grandparents grew up has fewer than fifty inhabitants.
questions.explanation: «Where» уживають, коли йдеться про місце.

questions.title: Which sentence contains a defining relative clause?
options: The book that you lent me was fascinating.
My brother, who lives in Poland, is a chef.
Kyiv, which is the capital, has a metro.
The film, which won three awards, was long.
questions.explanation: Defining clause не виділяється комами й уточнює, про що саме йдеться.

questions.title: In which sentence can the relative pronoun be left out?
options: The song that we heard yesterday was lovely.
The man who lives next door is a vet.
My cousin, who is a pilot, travels a lot.
The building, which was built in 1890, is protected.
questions.explanation: Відносний займенник можна опустити, коли він є додатком у підрядній частині.

questions.title: She is the only person ___ opinion I really value.
questions.explanation: «Whose» указує на належність і в non-defining, і в defining реченнях.

questions.title: There is ___ point in arguing with him about it.
questions.explanation: «No point in» — усталений зворот.

questions.title: Neither of the answers ___ acceptable to the committee.
questions.explanation: «Neither of» у формальному вживанні вимагає однини.

questions.title: We enjoyed the concert, ___ lasted almost three hours.
questions.explanation: Non-defining clause після коми вводиться займенником «which».

questions.title: Which sentence about pronoun use contains a mistake?
options: Between you and I, the plan will fail.
Between you and me, the plan will fail.
He told my sister and me the truth.
She invited my sister and me to dinner.
questions.explanation: Після прийменника «between» уживають об'єктну форму: «between you and me».

questions.title: They blamed ___ for the misunderstanding, although it was not their fault.
questions.explanation: Підмет і додаток збігаються, тому потрібен зворотний займенник.

questions.title: The two negotiators shook hands and congratulated ___.
questions.explanation: «Each other» уживають, коли двоє діють один щодо одного.

questions.title: ___ of the applicants who submitted a portfolio was invited to interview.
questions.explanation: «Every one of» вимагає дієслова в однині.

questions.title: It was on that evening ___ she finally made up her mind.
questions.explanation: У cleft-конструкції «It was … that» уживають «that».

questions.title: Match each relative clause with the type it belongs to.
pairs: The train that leaves at six is faster.
The train, which leaves at six, is faster.
The reason why she left is unclear.
The year when we met was 2012.
questions.explanation: Тип відносного речення визначає наявність ком і вибір займенника.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the meaning the pronoun creates.
pairs: each person looked in a mirror
two people looked at one another
they did the looking without help
questions.explanation: Зворотний, взаємний і особовий займенники дають три різні значення.

questions.title: Match each quantifying pronoun with the sentence it fits.
pairs: None of the shops were open.
Neither of the twins wanted to go.
You may take either of the seats.
Both of the seats were taken.
questions.explanation: Кожен кількісний займенник має свою сполучуваність і форму дієслова.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the function of 'it' in it.
pairs: It was my brother who called.
I found it on the shelf.
questions.explanation: Займенник «it» виконує в реченні кілька різних функцій.

questions.title: Match each faulty pronoun sentence with the reason it is wrong.
pairs: The book what I read was long.
what cannot introduce a relative clause
My brother, that lives abroad, is a pilot.
that is not used in non-defining clauses
She hurt himself on the stairs.
the reflexive does not match the subject
questions.explanation: Кожна помилка порушує своє правило: вибір займенника, тип речення, узгодження.

questions.title: The candidate ___ the committee eventually appointed had studied abroad.
questions.explanation: У формальному стилі як додаток уживають «whom».

questions.title: This is the point ___ the two arguments finally diverge.
questions.explanation: У формальному стилі прийменник ставлять перед відносним займенником.

questions.title: Which sentence uses a reduced relative clause correctly?
options: The documents submitted last week are still being processed.
The documents submitting last week are still processed.
The documents which submitted last week are processed.
The documents were submitted are still processed.
questions.explanation: Скорочене відносне речення утворюють дієприкметником без «which is».

questions.title: He offered several suggestions, ___ of which proved workable.
questions.explanation: У звороті «none of which» уживають «none» для повного заперечення.

questions.title: Which sentence is the most formal way of expressing the same idea?
options: The colleague with whom I collaborated has retired.
The colleague who I collaborated with has retired.
The colleague that I worked with has retired.
The colleague I worked with has retired.
questions.explanation: Формальний варіант ставить прийменник перед «whom».

questions.title: ___ takes on this task will need considerable patience.
questions.explanation: «Whoever» означає «той, хто» й уводить підрядну частину-підмет.

questions.title: Match each formal relative structure with its plain equivalent.
pairs: the report on which the decision was based
the report the decision was based on
the period during which prices fell
the extent to which it succeeded
a solution the merits of which are clear
a solution whose merits are clear
questions.explanation: Формальні відносні конструкції мають простіші розмовні відповідники.

questions.title: Match each pronoun structure with the emphasis it creates.
pairs: It was Anna who signed the letter.
It was the letter that Anna signed.
What Anna did was sign the letter.
emphasis that nobody else did it
questions.explanation: Різні конструкції виділяють різні частини речення.

questions.title: Match each generic reference strategy with an example of it.
pairs: singular they for an unknown person
If anyone objects, they should say so.
One should always check the sources.
You never know what will happen.
the passive to avoid an agent
Objections should be raised in writing.
questions.explanation: Узагальнену особу передають по-різному: singular they — нейтрально й сучасно, one — формально в письмі.

questions.title: Our New Neighbours — gap 1
questions.explanation: Перед іменником (one) потрібен присвійний займенник-означення: our one.

questions.title: Our New Neighbours — gap 2
questions.explanation: Діти батьків — присвійний займенник перед іменником: their.

questions.title: Our New Neighbours — gap 3
questions.explanation: Після help потрібен об'єктний займенник: helped her.

questions.title: Our New Neighbours — gap 4
questions.explanation: Сталий вираз know one's way around — присвійний займенник: his.

questions.title: Our New Neighbours — gap 5
questions.explanation: Займенник — додаток після invited (my sister and me), тож об'єктний відмінок.

questions.title: Cooking for the First Time — gap 1
questions.explanation: By ourselves — «самостійно»; форма ourself не існує, а by our own неграматичне (правильно on our own).

questions.title: Cooking for the First Time — gap 2
questions.explanation: Після прийменника of — об'єктний займенник: neither of us.

questions.title: Cooking for the First Time — gap 3
questions.explanation: Порізав сам себе — зворотний займенник: cut myself.

questions.title: Cooking for the First Time — gap 4
questions.explanation: Про двох осіб у запереченні — neither of us; no one of us неграматичне.

questions.title: Cooking for the First Time — gap 5
questions.explanation: Кожен із двох звинувачував іншого — each of us … the other.

questions.title: The Book That Travelled the World — gap 1
questions.explanation: Мова про одну конкретну книжку — займенник it.

questions.title: The Book That Travelled the World — gap 2
questions.explanation: Відносний займенник для людей у ролі підмета — who.

questions.title: The Book That Travelled the World — gap 3
questions.explanation: Ана — жінка, перед іменником life потрібен присвійний займенник: her.

questions.title: The Book That Travelled the World — gap 4
questions.explanation: Книжка — підмет підрядного речення: it would get.

questions.title: The Book That Travelled the World — gap 5
questions.explanation: Повідомлення тепер належать усім — присвійна форма everyone's.

questions.title: Twins Who Swapped Places — gap 1
questions.explanation: Tell somebody apart — об'єктний займенник: tell them apart.

questions.title: Twins Who Swapped Places — gap 2
questions.explanation: У запереченні (not to tell) — anyone; not … no one — подвійне заперечення.

questions.title: Twins Who Swapped Places — gap 3
questions.explanation: Зір бабусі — присвійний відносний займенник: whose eyesight.

questions.title: Twins Who Swapped Places — gap 4
questions.explanation: Pretend to be somebody — після be потрібен займенник you.

questions.title: Twins Who Swapped Places — gap 5
questions.explanation: Про одну з двох сестер щодо другої — one … the other.
